manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Fiend Hunter must be exiled by Wormfang Drake, and Changeling Berserker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Berserker for its mana cost.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
